title: Renewable Energy
summary: Misinformation about renewable energy sources including solar and wind power often overstates costs, reliability issues, and environmental impacts.
introduction: Renewable energy has become a focal point of climate action and energy policy, yet it faces persistent misinformation campaigns often funded by fossil fuel interests. Common myths exaggerate costs, reliability concerns, environmental impacts, and technological limitations while downplaying the rapid advances in battery storage, grid management, and cost reductions that have made renewable energy the cheapest electricity source in most markets. These myths can significantly impact public support for renewable energy projects and policy decisions, making evidence-based rebuttals essential for informed debate.
